description: All four crates (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-chain-simple) define Error enums that only derive Debug. The Rust ecosystem universally expects fmt::Display on error types, and impl std::error::Error behind a std feature flag. pkix-path and pkix-revocation are no_std so the pattern is: impl fmt::Display for Error unconditionally, plus #[cfg(feature=std)] impl std::error::Error for Error with a source() impl that chains to inner errors (e.g. Der(der::Error)).
title: Add Display and std::error::Error to all Error types
